title: Is the Hanover Institute an Independent Think Tank?
claim: The Hanover Institute is an independent, non-partisan public policy research organization.
truth: According to their own website's source code and legal disclaimers, the Hanover Institute is a PR operation distributed by Piro, Inc. on behalf of Havas Media Germany GmbH for the Israel Government Advertising Agency (LaPam). It is a registered FARA operation, not an independent academic institution.
source: Hanover Institute Source Code & FARA Records

faq.a: The Israel Government Advertising Agency (LaPam) through intermediate advertising firms.
No, they are PR and advertising materials, not academic research.

title: Did the IDF Build Civilian Deaths Into Strike Approvals in Gaza?
claim: NAZA's claim that the IDF routinely approved strikes expecting hundreds of civilian deaths is unverified and contradicts IDF policy.
truth: Hanover attempts to dismiss testimony from 24 military insiders by citing official IDF policies. However, independent investigations by Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch, and numerous UN special rapporteurs have documented extensive and disproportionate civilian casualties resulting from strikes on residential areas, suggesting systemic disregard for civilian life rather than adherence to stated policies.
source: Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch, UN Reports

faq.q: Do independent organizations verify IDF targeting claims?
faq.a: Independent human rights organizations repeatedly find discrepancies between stated IDF policies and the reality of disproportionate civilian harm on the ground.
